_photos: Where product photos replace the illustrations: "none" (illustrations everywhere), "pages" (photos on release pages only), or "all".

social._discord: Your Discord server's invite link (https://discord.gg/...). It's shown in the footer once it's filled in.
social._restockToX: Restock posts go to Bluesky and to X, and to Discord once DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL is set. Set this to false to keep them off X. Posts on X have no link in them, so each costs about 2 cents.
